biggest_catch: There is no annual fee, so the math is clean: a $200 cash bonus after $500 in 3 months is $200 net — the only real cost is meeting the spend with money you were spending anyway.
catches: Claim the bonus only with spending you already planned; never buy things you don't need just to hit the $500 target.
No annual fee on this card, so the fee does not eat the bonus — first-year net math is in the biggest catch above.
Applying for the card causes a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily lower your credit score.
The purchase APR is roughly 20%+; carrying a balance wipes out the $200 fast — pay the statement balance in full every month.
You are ineligible if you received a new-cardmember bonus for a Quicksilver account in the past 48 months (Capital One's 48-month same-product rule).
The bonus posts within two billing cycles, not immediately — keep the account open until it lands.

steps: Go to the official Capital One page https://www.capitalone.com/credit-cards/cash-back/quicksilver/ and read the $200 welcome-bonus terms ($500 in 3 months).
Confirm you have not received a Quicksilver new-cardmember bonus in the past 48 months.
Apply online through that official page and get approved.
Within the first 3 months, put $500 of already-planned purchases on the card — never extra spending for the bonus.
Pay the statement balance in full every month at ~20%+ APR; do not carry a balance.
Watch for the $200 cash bonus to post within two billing cycles of hitting the spend.
timing: Cash bonus posts within two billing cycles after you meet the $500-in-3-months spend requirement.
